Pathology image analysis

Our lab is involved with developing high throughput image analysis algorithms capable of measuring critical features of histology sides. Here, several features have been identified using some type of clustering technique. Importantly, these features and then be quantified and correlated with genomic information, such as specific transcriptional subclass, to offer insight into genetic bases to phenomena at a cellular level.
